description:
Success.co MCP Server lets you control your entire Success.co workspace directly from ChatGPT.

Instead of clicking around inside the app, you can simply talk to ChatGPT and ask it to do things for you. You can draft a new process document, complete a to do, create or update an Issue, review your Rocks, check on scorecard numbers, or prepare for an upcoming session. It works like a natural conversation, but it is connected to your real data.

Because Success.co already holds a clear, structured picture of how your company runs EOS, ChatGPT can use that data to generate powerful insights and reports. You can ask it to summarize execution across teams, highlight risks, spot patterns in Issues, or generate a planning brief. The only limit is what you choose to ask. It is your data, your operating system, simply made available to ChatGPT so you can leverage it more fully.

It is also especially useful when you are on the move. Using the ChatGPT app, you can add to dos or Issues with your voice, capture ideas as they happen, and keep execution moving without waiting to get back to your desk.

The Success.co MCP Server makes ChatGPT a practical control layer for your company’s EOS data, helping you move faster, think more clearly, and stay aligned.

defaultPrompt: Do a SWOT analysis of our company
